posts.abstract_en: A guide to applying to UCLA's Department of Design|Media Arts for Fall 2027, checked on official pages in October 2026. The single Design|Media Arts major has closed to new students and is replaced by three BA majors, Computational Art, Design and Games, each with about 60 students across four years, reviewed on first-choice major only with no swapping. Applicants submit the UC application by the end of November and a SlideRoom supplement, typically due mid-December, with artist statements and a visual portfolio. The review weighs the portfolio, UC PIQs, academic history and activities; no specific software is required, and faculty value conceptual focus, cohesion across pieces and a range of media.

title.zh-Hant: 康乃爾互動設計碩士怎麼選？Design Technology、M.A. Design、資訊科學 MPS、Connective Media 比較（2026 年 10 月官網查核）
title.en: How to choose a Cornell interaction design master's: Design Technology, M.A. Design, MPS in Information Science and Connective Media compared (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 康乃爾沒有單一的互動設計學位，相關碩士分散在 AAP、人類生態學院、Bowers 學院與 Cornell Tech。對照官網整理 M.S. Design Technology、M.A. Design（Design for Interaction）、MPS in Information Science 與 Connective Media 雙碩士的定位、背景要求、作品集規格、語言門檻與 2027 年截止日，並附本科 DEA Design Challenge 重點。
summary.en: Cornell has no single interaction design degree; related master's programmes sit in AAP, Human Ecology, Cornell Bowers and Cornell Tech. Checked against official pages: the focus, background requirements, portfolio rules, language minimums and 2027 deadlines of the M.S. Design Technology, M.A. Design (Design for Interaction), MPS in Information Science and the Connective Media dual master's, plus the undergraduate DEA Design Challenge.

tldr.zh-Hant: 康乃爾的互動設計相關碩士有四個：AAP 與 Cornell Tech 合辦的 M.S. Design Technology（兩年、研究論文或紐約工作室兩個方向、作品集最多 20 頁／20MB、1 月 4 日截止、STEM）；人類生態學院的 M.A. Design（兩年、研究論文、Design for Interaction 等四個方向、多數方向要求工作室型設計本科、數位作品集、TOEFL 105 或 IELTS 7.0、不提供資助）；Bowers 學院的 MPS in Information Science（可選 UX 方向、客戶項目、無作品集要求、需錄影面試、2027 秋季 2026 年 12 月 1 日截止）；Cornell Tech 的 Connective Media 雙碩士（Technion＋康乃爾兩個學位、技術導向、不收 GRE、TOEFL 100、優先截止 2027 年 1 月 5 日）。設計背景做研究選前兩個，走 UX 與產品職涯選後兩個。
tldr.en: Cornell has four interaction-design-related master's options: the M.S. Design Technology run by AAP and Cornell Tech (two years, thesis or New York studio track, portfolio up to 20 pages/20 MB, due 4 January, STEM); the M.A. Design at Human Ecology (two years, research thesis, four concentrations including Design for Interaction, most requiring a studio design undergraduate degree, digital portfolio, TOEFL 105 or IELTS 7.0, no funding); the MPS in Information Science at Cornell Bowers (optional UX focus, client project, no portfolio required, video interview, due 1 December 2026 for Fall 2027); and the Connective Media dual master's at Cornell Tech (Technion and Cornell degrees, technical, no GRE accepted, TOEFL 100, priority deadline 5 January 2027). Designers aiming at research should look at the first two; UX and product careers fit the last two.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：康乃爾大學（Cornell）沒有一個叫「互動設計」的單一學位，和互動設計、使用者體驗（UX）、人機互動相關的碩士分散在四個學院：建築藝術規劃學院（AAP）的 M.S. Design Technology、人類生態學院的 M.A. Design（含 Design for Interaction 方向）、Bowers 計算與資訊學院的 MPS in Information Science，以及紐約市 Cornell Tech 的 Connective Media 雙碩士。四者的背景要求、作品集、地點和截止日差很多：建築、室內、產品設計背景想做研究或實驗性設計，看前兩個；想走 UX、產品與資訊科技職涯，看後兩個。

以下內容於 2026 年 10 月逐一對照康乃爾各學院官網查核。舊資料中的學費數字、排名與部分語言分數未能在官網確認為最新，本文不寫；學費請以康乃爾 Bursar 與各學位頁面為準。

文首封面是 M.S. Design Technology 官網頁面上的圖片：以數位製造切割的木構曲面裝置，一位學生坐在構造下方。圖片來源：Cornell 官網

康乃爾互動設計碩士有哪幾個？一張表看差別

  • M.S. Design Technology（M.S. DT）：AAP 與 Cornell Tech 合辦的兩年制研究與項目型碩士；第一年都在伊薩卡（Ithaca），第二年依選擇的方向留在伊薩卡寫論文，或到紐約 Cornell Tech 修專業工作室。需要作品集。
  • M.A. Design：人類生態學院以人為本設計系（Human Centered Design）的兩年制碩士，以研究論文作結；四個方向之一就是 Design for Interaction。需要作品集，且多數方向要求本科為工作室型設計學位。
  • MPS in Information Science：Bowers 學院資訊科學系的專業碩士，沒有必修核心課，可選 UX（使用者體驗）等四個重點方向，並以為真實客戶做的 MPS Project 為核心。官網列出的申請材料沒有作品集，但要錄影面試。
  • Connective Media 雙碩士：Cornell Tech 上的 Jacobs Technion-Cornell 學院兩年制雙學位，同時拿以色列理工學院（Technion）與康乃爾的理學碩士，以電腦科學與工程為核心，結合人與社會面向的課程。

M.S. Design Technology 適合誰？申請要準備什麼？

官網說明，M.S. DT 讓學生在設計＋互動、設計＋材料、設計＋媒體、設計＋環境之間做跨領域研究，應用範圍涵蓋數位工具、產品、回應式材料與建成環境。核心師資來自 AAP、Bowers 計算與資訊學院、人類生態學院、工程學院與 Cornell Tech。官網列出的典型申請者背景包括建築或設計、工程、生物或材料科學、電腦科學。

  • 兩個方向：入學申請時就要在「研究論文方向（兩年都在伊薩卡）」與「專業工作室方向（第二年在紐約 Cornell Tech）」之間選一個。第一年兩者都修 Design and Making Across Disciplines、Design for Physical Interaction、Coding for Design 等核心課；工作室方向第二年修 Product Studio，再從 Startup、BigCo、PiTech 工作室中選一。
  • STEM 認定：官網寫明此學位被認定為 STEM（CIP 04.0902），國際畢業生可依規定延長 F-1 身分在美國工作最多三年。
  • 申請材料：兩封推薦信、所有就讀院校成績單、英語能力證明、個人陳述、學術目的陳述（須回答團隊合作經驗、如何面對團隊中的挑戰、職涯目標），以及作品集；履歷選交但強烈建議。
  • 作品集規格：數個項目、最多 20 頁或跨頁、檔案不超過 20MB，要和申請表同時上傳。合作或事務所作品必須逐張標明設計者人數、哪些部分由你完成、所有成員姓名；非設計背景的申請者可用已發表的科學或技術論文補充或取代作品集。
  • 截止與費用：2027 年秋季入學申請 9 月 15 日開放，所有材料須在 1 月 4 日前送達；申請費 105 美元、不退費。

M.A. Design 的 Design for Interaction 方向在做什麼？

M.A. Design 是兩年制、以研究論文作結的後專業學位，官網寫明適合本科讀室內設計、建築或產品設計，想做進階設計研究的人。四個方向是 Sustainable Design Studies、Design + Health、Emerging Technology for Design 與 Design for Interaction；學生另外要從全校各領域選一個副修。

  • Design for Interaction：研究人與設計環境如何互動，特別是室內空間，目標是培養能改善生活、提升場所品質、支持人在實體環境中體驗的設計師。
  • Emerging Technology for Design：涵蓋擴增實境（AR）、虛擬實境（VR）、建築機器人、生成與參數化設計與製造、BIM 模擬與人機互動等主題，官網說明畢業生適合在產業、研究機構與學術界從事運用 VR、AR 等技術的 UX 設計。
  • 背景要求：Sustainable Design Studies 方向偏好但不強制設計相關學位；其他方向（包括 Design for Interaction）要求本科為工作室型設計學位，例如室內設計、建築、產品設計。
  • 作品集：必須提交數位作品集，在研究生院申請系統的補充材料上傳，上限 20MB；作品以圖片呈現並附簡短項目說明，標明專業作品與學生作品、團隊作品中你的角色。官網特別提到，概念草圖、分析草圖與旅行速寫對評估能力很有幫助。
  • 語言與資助：國際生須提交 IELTS 總分 7.0 以上，或 TOEFL 總分 105 以上（並符合研究生院各項最低分：寫作 20、聽力 15、閱讀 20、口說 22）。官網寫明 M.A. 為 STEM 認定學位，但不提供碩士資助。
  • 截止日：只收秋季入學。官網頁面目前的申請期限段落寫 1 月 15 日，同頁常見問題則寫 12 月 1 日，送件前請以研究生院申請系統顯示的日期為準，最保險的做法是 12 月 1 日前完成。

MPS in Information Science 適合想走 UX 的人嗎？

適合想把 UX、產品設計與資料能力用在業界的人。官網說明，這個專業碩士沒有核心必修課，學生可依職涯自訂課表，並可選擇使用者體驗、資料科學、互動科技、網絡群體與市場四個重點方向之一；人工智慧貫穿整個課程。核心是 MPS Project：學生組隊為企業、非營利組織或機構客戶構思、設計並實作解決方案。官網列出的職涯方向包括 UX／UI 設計師、產品設計、UX 研究與產品經理等。

  • 申請材料：目的陳述、個人陳述、所有成績單、兩封推薦信、線上面試、官方語言成績與錄影面試；材料不齊或逾期不審，送出後不能修改。官網列出的必交材料沒有作品集。
  • 截止日：2027 年秋季入學截止為 2026 年 12 月 1 日（美東時間 23:59）；2027 年春季（1 月）入學截止為 2026 年 10 月 31 日。
  • 語言：康乃爾課程目錄列出 MPS 的 TOEFL iBT 單項最低分為口說 24、閱讀 20、聽力 15、寫作 20，比研究生院一般的口說要求更高。

Connective Media 雙碩士和其他三個差在哪？

Connective Media 是技術導向的學位。官網說明，它以電腦科學為中心，研究溝通、資訊與媒體匯流後形成的生態系，以及它們如何改變社會行為；兩年課程以項目制學習為主，並結合社會學、心理學、商業、創業與設計。畢業同時取得 Technion 的應用資訊科學理學碩士與康乃爾的資訊系統理學碩士，培養以人為本的軟體工程師、新產品開發者與技術型 UX 專家。2026–27 學年課表中包含 INFO 6410 HCI & Design 等課程。

  • 考試：Cornell Tech 官網寫明此雙碩士不需要也不接受 GRE；英語須 TOEFL 100 或 IELTS 7.0 以上，不接受合併最高分（superscore）。
  • 截止日（2027 年入學）：優先截止 2027 年 1 月 5 日、一般截止 2 月 2 日、滾動截止 4 月 1 日（皆為美東時間下午 5 點）；官網建議在優先截止前送件以爭取獎學金。
  • 只能選一個：每個申請週期在 Cornell Tech 只能申請一個碩士；伊薩卡校區的學位使用另一套申請系統，可以另外申請。

本科生想讀康乃爾互動設計，有什麼選擇？

本科層級可看人類生態學院的 B.S. Design + Environmental Analysis（DEA）。申請者除了 Common App，還必須透過 SlideRoom 提交 DEA Design Challenge，沒交不審。2027 年的四個部分是：手繪五格分鏡（為你社區中的人設計產品、空間或工具）、用 AI 生成替代方案的五格分鏡並寫下反思、3–5 件原創作品、以及課外活動履歷。截止日為提前決定（ED）2026 年 11 月 1 日、常規決定（RD）2027 年 1 月 2 日。想看康乃爾建築與 AAP 的整體介紹，可參考康乃爾 AAP 建築的口碑與選校重點。

怎麼選？依背景的建議

  1. 建築、室內、產品設計背景，想做互動空間研究：M.A. Design（Design for Interaction 或 Emerging Technology for Design），作品集裡放概念草圖與分析過程。
  2. 設計或工程背景，想做材料、製造、實體互動：M.S. Design Technology，作品集要清楚標出個人貢獻，並在學術目的陳述中寫好團隊合作經驗。
  3. 想直接進業界做 UX、產品：MPS in Information Science，重點放在陳述、推薦信與面試，作品集不是必交材料。
  4. 有程式基礎，想做技術型產品與媒體系統：Connective Media，留意它不收 GRE、英語門檻 TOEFL 100。

作者建議（非官網要求）：申請前先寫一句「我想研究或解決的人與科技的問題」，再回頭挑學位。設計背景的人常把作品集做成漂亮的渲染合集，但康乃爾這幾個學位都看得很細：誰做了什麼、研究問題是什麼、過程如何推進。把每個項目的問題、方法與你的角色寫清楚，比多放幾張圖有用。

官方查核來源：M.S. Design Technology、M.S. DT 課程與要求、AAP 研究生招生：Design Tech、M.A. Design、MPS in Information Science、MPS 申請、Connective Media 雙碩士、Connective Media 申請、Cornell Tech 招生常見問題、DEA Design Challenge（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: Cornell University has no single degree called "interaction design". Its master's options in interaction design, user experience (UX) and human-computer interaction sit in four different colleges: the M.S. in Design Technology at the College of Architecture, Art, and Planning (AAP), the M.A. in Design at Cornell Human Ecology (including a Design for Interaction concentration), the MPS in Information Science at Cornell Bowers, and the Connective Media dual master's at Cornell Tech in New York City. Their background requirements, portfolios, locations and deadlines differ a lot. If you come from architecture, interiors or product design and want research or experimental design, look at the first two; if you want a UX, product or information-technology career, look at the last two.

Everything below was checked against each Cornell college's official pages in October 2026. Older tuition figures, rankings and some language scores could not be confirmed as current, so they are left out; check the Cornell Bursar and each degree page for costs.

The cover image comes from the official M.S. Design Technology page: a digitally fabricated timber shell installation, with a student sitting beneath it. Image source: Cornell official website

Which Cornell interaction design master's degrees are there?

  • M.S. Design Technology (M.S. DT): a two-year research and project degree run jointly by AAP and Cornell Tech. Everyone spends year one in Ithaca; in year two you either stay in Ithaca for a thesis or move to Cornell Tech in New York for a professional studio track. A portfolio is required.
  • M.A. Design: a two-year degree in the Department of Human Centered Design at Cornell Human Ecology that ends in a research thesis; one of its four concentrations is Design for Interaction. A portfolio is required, and most concentrations require a studio-based design undergraduate degree.
  • MPS in Information Science: a professional master's in the Department of Information Science at Cornell Bowers, with no core courses, four optional focus areas including user experience, and a client-based MPS Project at its centre. The listed application materials do not include a portfolio, but there is a video interview.
  • Connective Media dual master's: a two-year dual degree from the Jacobs Technion-Cornell Institute at Cornell Tech, awarding master's degrees from both the Technion and Cornell, centred on computer science and engineering with courses on the human and social sides of technology.

Who is the M.S. Design Technology for, and what do you need to apply?

The official site says M.S. DT students do cross-disciplinary research across design + interaction, design + materials, design + media and design + environments, with applications in digital tools, products, responsive materials and the built environment. Core faculty come from AAP, Cornell Bowers, Cornell Human Ecology, Cornell Engineering and Cornell Tech. Likely candidates have degrees in architecture or design, engineering, biological or materials science, or computer science.

  • Two tracks: you choose at the application stage between a research thesis track (both years in Ithaca) and a studio professional track (year two at Cornell Tech in New York). In year one both tracks take core courses such as Design and Making Across Disciplines, Design for Physical Interaction and Coding for Design; the studio track then takes Product Studio and one of the Startup, BigCo or PiTech studios.
  • STEM designation: the degree is designated STEM (CIP 04.0902), so international graduates can extend F-1 status to work in the United States for up to three years.
  • Application materials: two recommendation letters, transcripts from every college attended, English proficiency, a personal statement, an academic statement of purpose (covering teamwork experience, how you handle team challenges and your career goals) and a portfolio; a résumé is optional but strongly encouraged.
  • Portfolio format: several projects, up to 20 pages or spreads and no larger than 20 MB, uploaded with the application. Group or office work must be labelled with the number of designers, which parts you produced and the names of all team members. Applicants from outside design can submit published scientific or technical papers in addition to, or instead of, a portfolio.
  • Deadline and fee: applications for Fall 2027 open on 15 September and all materials are due by 4 January; the application fee is US$105 and non-refundable.

What does the M.A. Design's Design for Interaction concentration cover?

The M.A. Design is a two-year, post-professional degree that ends in a research thesis. The official page says it is meant for students with an undergraduate degree in interior design, architecture or product design who want advanced design research. Its four concentrations are Sustainable Design Studies, Design + Health, Emerging Technology for Design and Design for Interaction, and students also choose a minor from fields across the university.

  • Design for Interaction: how people and designed environments interact, especially interior spaces, training designers to improve lives, enhance places and support people's experiences in physical settings.
  • Emerging Technology for Design: topics from augmented and virtual reality to architectural robotics, generative and parametric design and fabrication, BIM and simulation, and human-computer interaction; the page says graduates are well placed for UX design careers using VR, AR and other technologies in industry, research and academia.
  • Background: for Sustainable Design Studies a design-related degree is preferred but not required; for the other concentrations, including Design for Interaction, a studio-based undergraduate design degree (such as interior design, architecture or product design) is required.
  • Portfolio: a digital portfolio is required, uploaded as supplemental material in the Graduate School application (20 MB limit), with images and short project descriptions, marking professional versus student work and your role in group projects. The page notes that conceptual, analytical and travel sketches are very useful in assessing ability.
  • Language and funding: international applicants need an IELTS overall score of 7.0 or a TOEFL total of 105, plus the Graduate School section minimums (writing 20, listening 15, reading 20, speaking 22). The M.A. is STEM-certified, but funding is not provided for master's students.
  • Deadline: fall entry only. The deadline section of the page currently says 15 January, while the FAQ on the same page says 1 December, so check the date shown in the Graduate School application system; finishing by 1 December is the safest plan.

Is the MPS in Information Science a good fit for UX?

Yes, if you want to apply UX, product design and data skills in industry. The official site says the professional master's has no core courses, so students build a curriculum around their career goals and can choose one of four focus areas: user experience, data science, interactive technologies, or networks, crowds and markets, with AI running across the curriculum. Its centrepiece is the MPS Project, where student teams conceive, design and build solutions for companies, non-profits and agencies. Listed career paths include UX/UI designer, product design, UX research and product management.

  • Application materials: a statement of purpose, a personal statement, all transcripts, two reference letters, an online interview, official language test scores and a video interview; incomplete or late applications are not reviewed, and nothing can be changed after submission. A portfolio is not among the listed required materials.
  • Deadlines: 1 December 2026 (11:59 p.m. Eastern) for Fall 2027 entry, and 31 October 2026 for Spring 2027 (January) entry.
  • Language: the Cornell course catalogue lists MPS minimum TOEFL iBT section scores of speaking 24, reading 20, listening 15 and writing 20, a higher speaking bar than the general Graduate School minimum.

How is the Connective Media dual master's different?

Connective Media is the technical option. The official page describes it as the computer science-centred study of the ecosystems formed when communication, information and media converge, and how they change the way society behaves. The two-year, project-based curriculum also draws on sociology, psychology, business, entrepreneurship and design. Graduates receive an M.S. in Applied Information Science from the Technion and an M.S. in Information Systems from Cornell, and the programme trains human-centric software engineers, new product developers and technical UX specialists. The 2026–27 curriculum includes courses such as INFO 6410 HCI & Design.

  • Tests: Cornell Tech says the GRE is not required and not accepted for this dual degree; English requires TOEFL 100 or IELTS 7.0, and superscores are not accepted.
  • Deadlines (2027 entry): priority deadline 5 January 2027, round deadline 2 February and rolling deadline 1 April (all 5 p.m. Eastern); applying by the priority deadline is encouraged for scholarships.
  • One programme only: you can apply to only one Cornell Tech master's per cycle, though Ithaca-campus degrees use a separate application system and can be applied to as well.

What options are there for undergraduates?

At undergraduate level, look at the B.S. in Design + Environmental Analysis (DEA) at Cornell Human Ecology. Alongside the Common App, applicants must submit the DEA Design Challenge through SlideRoom, or they will not be considered. For 2027 it has four parts: a hand-drawn five-panel storyboard designing a product, space or tool for people in your community; an AI-generated five-panel alternative with your written reflections; 3–5 examples of original creative work; and a résumé of activities. Deadlines are 1 November 2026 for Early Decision and 2 January 2027 for Regular Decision. For an overview of Cornell architecture and AAP, see our guide to Cornell AAP architecture.

How to choose, by background

  1. Architecture, interiors or product design, interested in interactive spaces and research: the M.A. Design (Design for Interaction or Emerging Technology for Design), with conceptual sketches and analytical process in the portfolio.
  2. Design or engineering, interested in materials, fabrication and physical interaction: the M.S. Design Technology; label your individual contribution clearly and cover teamwork well in the academic statement.
  3. Heading straight into UX or product roles: the MPS in Information Science, where statements, references and interviews carry the application and a portfolio is not required.
  4. Coding background, interested in technical products and media systems: Connective Media; note that it does not accept the GRE and requires TOEFL 100.

The author's advice (not an official requirement): before applying, write one sentence on the problem between people and technology that you want to study or solve, then pick the degree. Design applicants often turn portfolios into collections of polished renderings, but these Cornell degrees look closely at who did what, what the research question is and how the process moved forward. Stating each project's question, method and your role clearly does more than adding extra images.

Official sources checked: M.S. Design Technology, M.S. DT curriculum and requirements, AAP graduate admissions: Design Tech, M.A. Design, MPS in Information Science, MPS application, Connective Media dual master's, Connective Media application, Cornell Tech admissions FAQ and the DEA Design Challenge (checked October 2026).

q.zh-Hant: 康乃爾有互動設計碩士嗎？
q.en: Does Cornell have an interaction design master's degree?

a.zh-Hant: 沒有單一名為互動設計的學位。相關碩士有 AAP 的 M.S. Design Technology、人類生態學院的 M.A. Design（Design for Interaction 方向）、Bowers 學院的 MPS in Information Science（UX 重點方向），以及 Cornell Tech 的 Connective Media 雙碩士。
a.en: There is no single degree called interaction design. The related master's options are AAP's M.S. Design Technology, Human Ecology's M.A. Design (Design for Interaction concentration), Cornell Bowers' MPS in Information Science (user experience focus area) and Cornell Tech's Connective Media dual master's.

q.zh-Hant: 康乃爾 M.S. Design Technology 作品集有什麼規定？
q.en: What are the portfolio rules for Cornell's M.S. Design Technology?

a.zh-Hant: 作品集應包含數個項目，最多 20 頁或跨頁、不超過 20MB，須和申請表同時上傳；合作或事務所作品要標明設計者人數、你負責的部分與所有成員。非設計背景可用已發表的科學或技術論文補充或取代作品集。
a.en: The portfolio should contain several projects, up to 20 pages or spreads and no larger than 20 MB, uploaded with the application. Group or office work must state the number of designers, which parts you produced and all team members. Applicants from outside design can submit published scientific or technical papers in addition to, or instead of, a portfolio.

q.zh-Hant: 康乃爾 M.A. Design 需要設計背景嗎？
q.en: Do I need a design background for Cornell's M.A. Design?

a.zh-Hant: 看方向。Sustainable Design Studies 偏好但不強制設計相關學位；其他方向，包括 Design for Interaction，要求本科為工作室型設計學位，例如室內設計、建築或產品設計。
a.en: It depends on the concentration. Sustainable Design Studies prefers but does not require a design-related degree; the other concentrations, including Design for Interaction, require a studio-based undergraduate design degree such as interior design, architecture or product design.

q.zh-Hant: 康乃爾 MPS in Information Science 需要作品集嗎？
q.en: Does Cornell's MPS in Information Science require a portfolio?

a.zh-Hant: 官網列出的必交材料沒有作品集，包括目的陳述、個人陳述、成績單、兩封推薦信、線上面試、官方語言成績與錄影面試。2027 年秋季入學截止為 2026 年 12 月 1 日。
a.en: A portfolio is not among the listed required materials, which are a statement of purpose, a personal statement, transcripts, two reference letters, an online interview, official language scores and a video interview. The Fall 2027 deadline is 1 December 2026.

q.zh-Hant: Cornell Tech Connective Media 要考 GRE 嗎？
q.en: Does Cornell Tech's Connective Media require the GRE?

a.zh-Hant: 不需要，也不接受 GRE。英語須 TOEFL 100 或 IELTS 7.0 以上，不接受合併最高分。2027 年入學的優先截止為 2027 年 1 月 5 日。
a.en: No; the GRE is neither required nor accepted. English requires TOEFL 100 or IELTS 7.0, without superscores. The priority deadline for 2027 entry is 5 January 2027.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：哈爾濱工業大學（哈工大）與香港理工大學（理大）合辦的「哈爾濱工業大學香港理工大學深圳國際設計學院」已經揭牌，2027/28 學年首次招收全日制碩士，開設設計、智能科學與技術、城鄉規劃三個專業，首屆計畫招收 150 人。學制三年、三年都在哈工大深圳校區上課（3+0 模式，由理大教師到校授課與指導），畢業可分別取得哈工大與理大的碩士學位證書。它走的是中國內地研究生招生路線：考生須參加全國碩士研究生招生考試，或以推薦免試入學；學費每年人民幣 15 萬元。

以下內容於 2026 年 10 月對照哈工大深圳國際設計學院官網的《2027 年全日制碩士研究生招生簡介》、揭牌新聞，以及理大官方新聞稿查核。早期流傳的「2026 年首屆招生」「每個專業每年 100 人」等說法已和官方最新資訊不同，本文一律以官網為準。

文首封面是學院官網揭牌新聞中「學院基礎設施及實驗室」的照片：挑高木格柵天花下的開放式學習與工作空間。圖片來源：哈工大深圳國際設計學院官網

哈工大與理大合辦的深圳國際設計學院是什麼？

根據招生簡介，這是中國教育部批准設立、隸屬於哈工大、不具獨立法人資格的內地與港澳合作辦學機構，辦學地點在深圳大學城的哈工大深圳校區。理大新聞稿說明，兩校於 2026 年 9 月 24 日在哈工大深圳校區舉行揭牌儀式，同日成立「未來設計聯合研究中心」，研究方向包括未來生活與智慧城市、系統整合設計，以及文化、藝術與數位媒體技術。

學院的定位是把哈工大的工程技術與理大的設計教育結合，加強藝術設計、工科技術與人工智慧的交叉，培養「設計＋科技」的複合型人才。

開哪三個碩士專業？畢業拿到什麼學位？

招生簡介列出 2027 年三個招生專業與畢業後分別頒發的證書如下：

  • 設計（135700）：哈工大設計學科畢業證書與設計碩士學位證書，加上理大的設計學（智能系統設計）碩士學位證書。
  • 智能科學與技術（087600）：哈工大智能科學與技術學科畢業證書與工學碩士學位證書，加上理大的多媒體創娛理學碩士學位證書。
  • 城鄉規劃（085300）：哈工大城鄉規劃學科畢業證書與城鄉規劃碩士學位證書，加上理大的設計學（城市環境設計）碩士學位證書。

三個專業合計招生計畫 150 人（實際人數以當年招生計畫為準），皆為全日制碩士。要拿到兩校學位，須在規定年限內修完學分、完成培養方案要求，並同時達到兩校的學位授予標準。

要去香港上課嗎？用什麼語言教學？

不用。招生簡介寫明採「3+0」模式：碩士三年都在哈工大深圳校區培養，由理大教師到深圳授課和指導。教學使用中文與英文，其中理大的課程以英文授課。

英文要多好？雅思、托福、四六級怎麼算？

考生在複試時須符合以下任一條件（IELTS 與 TOEFL 須為兩年內單次考試成績）：

  • IELTS 學術類：6.0 以上。
  • TOEFL iBT：80 分以上（滿分 120）；2026 年 1 月 21 日或之後參加的新制考試為 4.5 分以上（滿分 6）。
  • 大學英語四級（CET-4）：550 分以上，且須另外參加並通過理大英語能力評估。
  • 大學英語六級（CET-6）：500 分以上，且須另外參加並通過理大英語能力評估。

TOEFL iBT Home Edition、IELTS Online、IELTS Indicator 與 IELTS 單科重考（One Skill Retake）成績都不被接受。

怎麼報考？要作品集嗎？

這個學院納入哈工大當年的碩士研究生招生計畫，錄取程序與一般非合作辦學招生相同，有兩條路：

  • 全國統考：透過中國研究生招生信息網（研招網）報名，報考條件與考試科目以哈工大 2027 年碩士研究生招生章程與統考招生目錄為準。
  • 推薦免試：2027 年推免報名已於 2026 年 9 月 15 日截止。官網列出的背景要求是：設計專業收工業設計、數位媒體藝術等設計學相關背景；智能科學與技術收電腦科學與技術、人工智慧、數位媒體技術、自動化等背景；城鄉規劃收城鄉規劃、環境設計等背景。有相關設計作品、科研或實踐經歷者優先。

推免申請材料包括履歷、成績單與排名證明、外語能力證明、學術成果與獲獎證明；作品集不是必交，但有作品集可另外寄送（壓縮在 50MB 以內）。從「有設計作品者優先」這句話來看，準備一份能說清楚設計過程的作品集，對設計與城鄉規劃方向都是加分項。

學費多少？有宿舍嗎？

  • 學費：每生每學年人民幣 15 萬元，三年合計 45 萬元。
  • 獎助學金：依學校最新政策執行，官網未列出具體金額。
  • 住宿：深圳校區不提供住宿，須自行安排。

適合哪些人？和直接申請理大設計碩士差在哪？

  1. 已經準備考研、想同時拿到內地與香港學位的人：這是最直接的對象，報考流程與一般考研相同。
  2. 想讀設計又重視工科與人工智慧訓練的人：設計專業對應理大的智能系統設計方向，智能科學與技術專業則對應多媒體創娛。
  3. 規劃與環境設計背景的人：城鄉規劃專業對應理大的城市環境設計學位。

差別在於路線：直接申請理大的授課型碩士，是向理大提交國際或本地申請，一般一年制、在香港上課；這個合作學院則是三年制、在深圳上課，入學要走內地考研或推免，學費也不同。兩條路適合的人不太一樣，先確認自己能不能參加內地研究生招生考試，再決定方向。想了解理大設計學院的本科申請，可參考我們的香港設計與建築本科 2027 申請匯總。

作者建議（非官方要求）：三年制、跨兩校的合作學位，關鍵在於你能不能善用「設計＋工程」的資源。無論走統考還是推免，都建議先想清楚自己想研究的問題，例如智慧空間、互動產品或城市數據，再把作品集或研究計畫圍繞這個問題整理；複試時能說清楚為什麼需要這種交叉訓練，比單純強調雙學位更有說服力。

官方查核來源：哈工大香港理工大學深圳國際設計學院 2027 年全日制碩士研究生招生簡介、學院揭牌儀式新聞、香港理工大學新聞稿（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the Harbin Institute of Technology–The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Shenzhen International School of Design (SISD), run jointly by Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT) and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU), has been officially launched and will take its first full-time master's students in academic year 2027/28. It offers three programmes, Design, Intelligent Science and Technology, and Urban and Rural Planning, with a planned first intake of 150. The programmes last three years and are taught entirely on HIT's Shenzhen campus (a "3+0" model in which PolyU staff come to Shenzhen to teach and supervise), and graduates receive separate master's degree certificates from HIT and PolyU. Admission follows the mainland Chinese postgraduate route: candidates sit the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination or are admitted through recommendation without examination. Tuition is RMB 150,000 a year.

Everything below was checked in October 2026 against the school's official 2027 full-time master's admissions brochure, its launch news on the school website and PolyU's official press release. Earlier claims that the first intake would be in 2026 or that each programme would admit 100 students a year no longer match official information; this article follows the official sources.

The cover image comes from the "facilities and laboratories" photos in the school's launch news: an open study and work space under a high timber-slatted ceiling. Image source: HIT Shenzhen International School of Design website

What is the HIT–PolyU Shenzhen International School of Design?

According to the admissions brochure, it is a mainland–Hong Kong cooperative education institution approved by China's Ministry of Education, belonging to HIT and without independent legal-person status, located on HIT's Shenzhen campus in Shenzhen University Town. PolyU's press release says the two universities held the launch ceremony on HIT's Shenzhen campus on 24 September 2026 and opened the Future Design Joint Research Centre the same day, with research areas covering future living and smart cities, systems integration design, and culture, arts and digital media technologies.

The school aims to combine HIT's engineering strengths with PolyU's design education, integrating art and design, engineering and artificial intelligence to train graduates who bring design and technology together.

Which three master's programmes are offered, and which degrees do graduates receive?

The brochure lists the three 2027 programmes and the certificates awarded as follows:

  • Design (135700): an HIT graduation certificate and Master of Design degree, plus a PolyU master's degree in Design (Intelligent Systems Design).
  • Intelligent Science and Technology (087600): an HIT graduation certificate and Master of Engineering degree, plus a PolyU master of science degree in multimedia and entertainment technology.
  • Urban and Rural Planning (085300): an HIT graduation certificate and Master of Urban Planning degree, plus a PolyU master's degree in Design (Urban Environments Design).

The three programmes have a combined planned intake of 150 (the actual number follows that year's admissions plan), all full time. To receive both degrees, students must complete the required credits and programme requirements within the set period and meet both universities' degree-award standards.

Do students study in Hong Kong, and what is the language of teaching?

No. The brochure states a "3+0" model: all three years take place on HIT's Shenzhen campus, with PolyU teachers coming to Shenzhen to teach and supervise. Teaching is in Chinese and English, and PolyU's courses are taught in English.

What English level is needed: IELTS, TOEFL or CET?

At the re-examination stage, candidates must meet any one of the following (IELTS and TOEFL must be single-sitting results from within the last two years):

  • IELTS Academic: 6.0 or above.
  • TOEFL iBT: 80 or above (out of 120), or 4.5 or above (out of 6) for tests taken on or after 21 January 2026.
  • College English Test Band 4 (CET-4): 550 or above, plus passing a PolyU English proficiency assessment.
  • College English Test Band 6 (CET-6): 500 or above, plus passing a PolyU English proficiency assessment.

TOEFL iBT Home Edition, IELTS Online, the IELTS Indicator test and IELTS One Skill Retake results are not accepted.

How do you apply, and is a portfolio required?

The school is part of HIT's master's admissions plan for the year, and admission follows the same procedures as regular non-cooperative programmes. There are two routes:

  • National examination: register through the China Graduate Admissions Information Network (yz.chsi.com.cn); eligibility and exam subjects follow HIT's 2027 master's admissions regulations and examination catalogue.
  • Recommendation without examination: registration for the 2027 round closed on 15 September 2026. The listed backgrounds are design-related degrees such as industrial design or digital media art for Design; computer science and technology, artificial intelligence, digital media technology, automation and similar for Intelligent Science and Technology; and urban and rural planning, environmental design and similar for Urban and Rural Planning. Applicants with relevant design work, research or practical experience are given priority.

Recommendation applicants submit a CV, transcripts and ranking certificates, proof of foreign-language ability, academic outputs and award certificates. A portfolio is not compulsory, but one can be sent separately (compressed to under 50 MB). Since applicants with design work are given priority, a portfolio that clearly explains the design process is an advantage for both the Design and the Urban and Rural Planning programmes.

How much are the fees, and is housing provided?

  • Tuition: RMB 150,000 per student per year, or RMB 450,000 over three years.
  • Scholarships and grants: according to the university's latest policies; no specific amounts are listed.
  • Housing: the Shenzhen campus does not provide accommodation, so students arrange their own.

Who is it for, and how does it differ from applying to a PolyU design master's directly?

  1. Students already preparing for the mainland postgraduate exam who want both a mainland and a Hong Kong degree: this is the most direct fit, and the process is the same as a regular postgraduate application.
  2. Design students who want stronger engineering and AI training: the Design programme leads to PolyU's Intelligent Systems Design degree, while Intelligent Science and Technology leads to multimedia and entertainment technology.
  3. Planning and environmental design graduates: Urban and Rural Planning leads to PolyU's Urban Environments Design degree.

The difference is the route. Applying directly to a PolyU taught master's means submitting an international or local application to PolyU, usually for a one-year programme in Hong Kong; this cooperative school is a three-year programme in Shenzhen that you enter through the mainland exam or recommendation, with different fees. They suit different people, so first check whether you can take part in mainland postgraduate admissions, then choose. For PolyU's undergraduate design admissions, see our guide to Hong Kong design and architecture undergraduate degrees for 2027.

The author's advice (not an official requirement): in a three-year joint degree spanning two universities, what matters is whether you can make use of the design-plus-engineering resources. Whichever route you take, decide first on the question you want to study, such as smart spaces, interactive products or urban data, and organise your portfolio or research plan around it. At the re-examination, explaining why you need this kind of cross-disciplinary training is more convincing than stressing the double degree.

Official sources checked: HIT–PolyU Shenzhen International School of Design 2027 full-time master's admissions brochure, school launch ceremony news and PolyU press release (checked October 2026).

q.zh-Hant: 哈工大香港理工大學深圳國際設計學院什麼時候開始招生？
q.en: When does the HIT–PolyU Shenzhen International School of Design start admitting students?

a.zh-Hant: 2027/28 學年首次招收全日制碩士，設計、智能科學與技術、城鄉規劃三個專業合計計畫招收 150 人，實際人數以當年招生計畫為準。
a.en: Its first full-time master's students start in academic year 2027/28, with a combined planned intake of 150 across Design, Intelligent Science and Technology, and Urban and Rural Planning; the actual number follows that year's admissions plan.

q.zh-Hant: 畢業可以拿到香港理工大學的學位嗎？
q.en: Do graduates receive a PolyU degree?

a.zh-Hant: 可以。達到兩校學位授予標準者，分別取得哈工大的畢業證書與碩士學位證書，以及理大對應的碩士學位證書，例如設計專業對應理大設計學（智能系統設計）碩士。
a.en: Yes. Students who meet both universities' degree standards receive HIT's graduation certificate and master's degree plus the corresponding PolyU master's degree; for example, the Design programme leads to a PolyU master's in Design (Intelligent Systems Design).

q.zh-Hant: 需要到香港上課嗎？
q.en: Do I have to study in Hong Kong?

a.zh-Hant: 不需要。採 3+0 模式，三年都在哈工大深圳校區，由理大教師到深圳授課與指導；理大課程以英文授課。
a.en: No. It uses a 3+0 model: all three years are on HIT's Shenzhen campus, with PolyU teachers coming to Shenzhen; PolyU courses are taught in English.

q.zh-Hant: 英文要求是多少？
q.en: What are the English requirements?

a.zh-Hant: 複試時須符合其一：IELTS 學術類 6.0、TOEFL iBT 80（新制 4.5），或 CET-4 550、CET-6 500 且通過理大英語能力評估。不接受 TOEFL 家庭版、IELTS Online、IELTS Indicator 與單科重考成績。
a.en: At the re-examination you need one of: IELTS Academic 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80 (or 4.5 on the new scale), or CET-4 550 or CET-6 500 plus passing a PolyU English assessment. TOEFL Home Edition, IELTS Online, IELTS Indicator and One Skill Retake results are not accepted.

q.zh-Hant: 學費多少？有提供宿舍嗎？
q.en: How much is tuition, and is housing provided?

a.zh-Hant: 學費每生每學年人民幣 15 萬元；深圳校區不提供住宿，須自行安排。獎助學金依學校最新政策執行。
a.en: Tuition is RMB 150,000 per student per year. The Shenzhen campus does not provide housing, so students arrange their own. Scholarships and grants follow the university's latest policies.

posts.abstract_en: A guide to the Harbin Institute of Technology–The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Shenzhen International School of Design, checked against official sources in October 2026. The school, approved by China's Ministry of Education and launched on 24 September 2026, takes its first full-time master's students in 2027/28 (planned intake 150) in Design, Intelligent Science and Technology, and Urban and Rural Planning. Programmes run three years on HIT's Shenzhen campus (3+0) and award separate HIT and PolyU master's degrees. Entry is via the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination or recommendation; English requires IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80, or CET-4 550/CET-6 500 with a PolyU assessment; tuition is RMB 150,000 a year with no campus housing.

title.en: How to apply to HKU's AI film master's (MACAIFM): 2027 entry requirements, video materials, fees and deadline (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 香港大學未來媒體學院的創意人工智能電影與媒體文學碩士（MACAIFM）2027/28 入學申請已開放，2027 年 1 月 15 日截止。對照官網整理 1.5 年 60 學分課程結構、雅思托福要求、自我介紹影片與入學影片等申請材料、港幣 348,000 元學費、獎學金與申請時間線。
summary.en: Applications for 2027/28 entry to the Master of Arts in Creative Artificial Intelligence Film and Media (MACAIFM) at HKU's School of Future Media are open until 15 January 2027. Checked against the official website: the 1.5-year, 60-credit curriculum, IELTS/TOEFL requirements, the self-introduction video and entry film, the HK$348,000 fee, scholarships and the application timeline.

tldr.zh-Hant: 港大 AI 電影碩士正式名稱為 Master of Arts in Creative Artificial Intelligence Film and Media（MACAIFM），由未來媒體學院開辦；1.5 年全日制、60 學分（6 門核心、2 門選修、1 個畢業項目）；2027-28 學費港幣 348,000 元；英文須 IELTS 6.5（單項 6.0）或 TOEFL 90（新制 4.5）；申請材料為 3 分鐘內英文自我介紹影片、至少 5 分鐘的入學影片（不收 showreel）、履歷與學歷證明，入圍者面試；2026 年 10 月 2 日開放、滾動審核，2027 年 1 月 15 日中午截止。
tldr.en: HKU's AI film master's is officially the Master of Arts in Creative Artificial Intelligence Film and Media (MACAIFM), run by the School of Future Media. It is 1.5 years full time with 60 credits (six core courses, two electives and a capstone), and 2027-28 tuition is HK$348,000. English requires IELTS 6.5 (no sub-test below 6.0) or TOEFL 90 (4.5 on the new scale). Applicants submit an English self-introduction video of up to 3 minutes, an entry film of at least 5 minutes (no showreels), a CV and degree proof, and shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Applications opened on 2 October 2026 with rolling review and close at noon on 15 January 2027.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：香港大學未來媒體學院（School of Future Media）的 AI 電影碩士，現在的正式名稱是 Master of Arts in Creative Artificial Intelligence Film and Media（MACAIFM，創意人工智能電影與媒體文學碩士）。2027/28 學年入學的申請已於 2026 年 10 月 2 日開放，截止時間是 2027 年 1 月 15 日中午 12 時（香港時間），採滾動審核與面試。課程為 1.5 年全日制、60 學分，2027-28 學年學費為 港幣 348,000 元（本地與非本地學生相同）。申請不是交傳統作品集，而是要交一支 3 分鐘以內的英文自我介紹影片，以及一部至少 5 分鐘、由你創作或擔任關鍵角色的影片。

以下內容於 2026 年 10 月對照港大未來媒體學院的課程首頁、課程介紹頁、申請頁，以及港大研究生入學系統上的 2027 年入學課程資料查核。早期流傳的版本（舊名「AI Filmmaking and Media」、一年制、學費港幣 33.6 萬元、雅思 6.5 或托福 80）已和官網最新資訊不同，本文一律以官網為準；市場規模、薪資等無法從官方查證的數字也一併刪除。

文首封面是課程首頁的主視覺。圖片來源：香港大學未來媒體學院官網

港大 AI 電影碩士 MACAIFM 是什麼課程？

官網把 MACAIFM 形容為亞洲一個開創性的研究生課程，目標是把生成式 AI 技術整合進傳統電影與媒體創作，培養「說故事的人」與創新者。1.5 年的密集學習中，課程訓練導演、攝影、剪輯與 AI 輔助製作，並提供學生作品在國際影展展出的機會。課程資料顯示，課程隸屬港大社會科學學院，由未來媒體學院開辦；全日制修業年限最短 1.5 年、最長 3 年。

課程首頁列出的教學團隊包括奧斯卡紀錄片得主 Ruby Yang、擔任課程主任的獲獎電影人 Uli Gaulke，以及擔任副課程主任的生成式 AI 專家 Foon Lee 等人。

要修哪些課？60 學分怎麼分配？

60 學分由 6 門核心課（36 學分）、2 門選修課（12 學分）與 1 個畢業項目（12 學分）組成：

  • 核心課：電影製作中的生成式 AI（SOFM7001）、劇情與紀錄片製作基礎（SOFM7002）、數位人：AI 與虛擬化身（SOFM7003）、進階電影生成式 AI（SOFM7004）、混合敘事工作室：紀錄片、動畫與 AI（SOFM7005）、電影、媒體與 AI 敘事寫作（SOFM7006）。
  • 選修課：電影風格與技術（SOFM7011）、AI 與廣告（SOFM7012）、創意監製與創業（SOFM7013）、生成式 AI 藝術的美學、能動性與作者身分（SOFM7014）、電影理論與批評（SOFM7015）；官網註明不是每門課每年都開。
  • 畢業項目：AI 驅動的電影／媒體作品（SOFM7010）。

換句話說，這不是只學 AI 工具的課程：一半以上的核心課仍圍繞劇情、紀錄片、寫作與敘事，AI 是被放進電影語言裡使用的。

申請條件是什麼？雅思、托福要多少？

  • 學歷：學士學位或同等學歷，官網註明以電影研究或媒體製作背景為佳（不是硬性限制）。
  • 英文（以非英語授課學位申請者適用）：IELTS 總分 6.5 且各單項不低於 6.0；或 TOEFL 90 分以上（2026 年 1 月 21 日前的考試），2026 年 1 月 21 日起的新制考試為 1–6 級制總分 4.5 以上；或其他官網列出的英文資格。
  • 沒有學士學位的例外情況：在電影或相關產業有至少 10 年專業經驗，或執導過兩部獲獎電影、或曾監製多部獲獎電影，並證明英文能力者，在特殊情況下可獲准入學。
  • 面試：入圍者會受邀參加未來媒體學院的面試，現場或 Zoom 進行。

要交作品集嗎？申請材料有哪些？

官網列出的申請材料是「影片優先」：

  1. 自我介紹影片：最長 3 分鐘、用英文回答四個問題：簡單介紹自己；AI 對你的意義、你是怎麼接觸到它的；為什麼想用生成式 AI 創作電影；什麼是好的 AI 電影。
  2. 入學影片（Entry Film）：一部由你創作或擔任關鍵角色、至少 5 分鐘的影片，類型可為劇情、紀錄片或 AI 生成內容，不接受 showreel（作品剪輯集錦）。另附文件說明片名、片長、製作年份與簡介，並列出完整工作人員名單（導演、編劇、攝影、剪輯、聲音設計、AI 工具操作等），清楚標明你在片中的角色。
  3. 履歷（CV）：包括聯絡電郵、英文程度、學歷、相關經驗與技能，以及在電影、媒體或 AI 產業的作品經歷。
  4. 學歷證明（必交）與英文成績（如適用）。

申請費為每份港幣 780 元，透過港大研究生線上申請系統提交。

學費多少？有獎學金嗎？

  • 學費：2027-28 學年（1.5 年全日制）港幣 348,000 元，本地與非本地學生相同，即 60 學分 × 每學分港幣 5,800 元。
  • 獎學金：未來媒體學院碩士獎學金頁面說明，獲錄取者會被考慮獎學金，表現特別優秀者可獲全額獎學金；以學術或專業表現為依據，名額與金額由評選委員會依當年經費決定，官網未列固定金額。

2027 申請時間線怎麼排？

  • 2026 年 10 月 2 日：開放申請。
  • 2026 年 11 月 11 日（週三）18:00–19:00（香港時間）：Zoom 線上招生說明會。
  • 滾動審核與面試：收件後陸續進行，有條件錄取結果也是滾動公布。
  • 2027 年 1 月 15 日中午 12 時（香港時間）：申請截止。官網另註明若到 2027 年 5 月 31 日仍未收到結果，可聯絡學院查詢。

因為是滾動審核，越早把兩支影片準備好、越早送件，通常越有利。

適合哪些人申請？

  1. 已經有拍片經驗、想把生成式 AI 帶進創作的人：入學影片至少 5 分鐘，代表你需要一部完整作品，而不是零散片段。
  2. 設計、建築、動畫或媒體背景、想轉向影像敘事的人：官網偏好電影或媒體背景但沒有限制本科專業，關鍵是你能交出一部說得清楚自己角色的影片。
  3. 想在香港讀一個比一般一年制授課碩士更長、實作更多的課程的人：1.5 年的學制留給畢業項目更完整的製作時間。

作者建議（非官方要求）：申請重點不是展示你會用多少 AI 工具，而是回答官網那題「什麼是好的 AI 電影」。我們在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中看到，能打動評審的影像作品，通常有一個清楚的問題意識和明確的個人角色。建議先寫下你想透過 AI 說的故事，再決定入學影片要放哪一部，並在工作人員名單中誠實標清楚自己負責的部分。想了解港大本科的設計與建築申請，可參考我們的香港設計與建築本科 2027 申請匯總。

官方查核來源：港大未來媒體學院 MACAIFM 課程首頁、課程介紹、申請資訊、碩士獎學金、港大 2027 年入學課程資料（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the AI film master's at the University of Hong Kong's School of Future Media is now officially called the Master of Arts in Creative Artificial Intelligence Film and Media (MACAIFM). Applications for 2027/28 entry opened on 2 October 2026 and close at 12:00 noon (Hong Kong time) on 15 January 2027, with rolling review and interviews. The programme is 1.5 years full time with 60 credits, and the 2027-28 tuition fee is HK$348,000 for both local and non-local students. Instead of a traditional portfolio, you submit a self-introduction video in English of up to 3 minutes and a film of at least 5 minutes that you created or played a key role in.

Everything below was checked in October 2026 against the School of Future Media's programme home page, programme details page and application page, and the 2027 programme information on HKU's postgraduate admissions system. Earlier versions in circulation (the old name "AI Filmmaking and Media", a one-year duration, a HK$336,000 fee, and IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80) no longer match the official information; this article follows the official sources, and market-size and salary figures that cannot be verified officially have been removed.

The cover is the key visual from the programme home page. Image source: HKU School of Future Media website

What is HKU's MACAIFM AI film master's?

The official website describes MACAIFM as a pioneering postgraduate programme in Asia dedicated to integrating generative AI technologies into traditional film and media creation, aimed at visionary storytellers and innovators. Over an intensive 1.5 years it offers training in directing, cinematography, editing and AI-enhanced production, with opportunities to show work at international film festivals. The programme information shows it sits in HKU's Faculty of Social Sciences and is run by the School of Future Media; full-time study lasts no less than 1.5 and no more than 3 academic years.

The teaching team listed on the home page includes Oscar-winning documentary filmmaker Ruby Yang, award-winning filmmaker and programme director Uli Gaulke, and generative AI expert and deputy programme director Foon Lee, among others.

What do you study, and how are the 60 credits divided?

The 60 credits consist of six core courses (36 credits), two electives (12 credits) and a capstone project (12 credits):

  • Core courses: Generative AI in Filmmaking (SOFM7001), Filmmaking in Fiction and Documentary Foundations (SOFM7002), The Digital Human – AI & Avatars (SOFM7003), Advanced Generative AI in Filmmaking (SOFM7004), Hybrid Storytelling Studio: Documentary, Animation & AI (SOFM7005) and Writing for Film, Media & AI Storytelling (SOFM7006).
  • Electives: Film Style & Technology (SOFM7011), AI & Commercials (SOFM7012), Creative Producing & Entrepreneurship (SOFM7013), Aesthetics, Agency and Authorship of Generative AI Art (SOFM7014) and Film Theory and Criticism (SOFM7015); the website notes that not all courses are offered every year.
  • Capstone: AI-Driven Film / Media Work (SOFM7010).

In other words, this is not just a course in AI tools: more than half of the core courses still centre on fiction, documentary, writing and storytelling, with AI used within the language of film.

What are the entry requirements, and what IELTS or TOEFL score is needed?

  • Degree: a bachelor's degree or equivalent, preferably in film studies or media production (a preference, not a strict requirement).
  • English (for applicants whose degree was not taught in English): IELTS 6.5 overall with no sub-test below 6.0; or TOEFL 90 or above for tests taken before 21 January 2026, or 4.5 or above on the 1–6 band scale for tests from 21 January 2026; or another English qualification listed on the website.
  • Exceptions without a bachelor's degree: in exceptional circumstances, applicants with at least ten years of professional experience in film or a related industry, or who have directed two award-winning films or produced multiple award-winning films, and who show English competence, may be admitted.
  • Interview: shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the School of Future Media, in person or via Zoom.

Is a portfolio required, and what are the application materials?

The materials listed on the website are video-first:

  1. Self-introduction video: up to 3 minutes, answering four questions in English: briefly introduce yourself; what AI means to you and how you came across it; why you want to create films using generative AI; and what makes a good AI film.
  2. Entry film: a film you created or played a crucial part in, at least 5 minutes long, in fiction, documentary or AI-generated content, with no showreels accepted. Include a document with the title, length, year of production and summary, a full credit list (director, writer, cinematographer, editor, sound designer, AI tool operator and so on) and a clear statement of your role.
  3. CV: including your contact email, English level, academic background, relevant experience and skills, and any prior work in film, media or AI industries.
  4. Proof of university qualifications (mandatory) and English test results (if applicable).

The application fee is HK$780 per application, submitted through HKU's online taught postgraduate application system.

How much is tuition, and are there scholarships?

  • Tuition: HK$348,000 for 2027-28 (1.5 years full time), the same for local and non-local students, i.e. 60 credits at HK$5,800 per credit.
  • Scholarships: the School of Future Media's master's scholarships page says admitted applicants will be considered for awards, with full scholarships for exceptional candidates. Awards are based on academic or professional merit, and the number and value are set by the selection committee according to the funds available each year; no fixed amounts are listed.

What is the 2027 application timeline?

  • 2 October 2026: applications open.
  • Wednesday 11 November 2026, 6:00–7:00 pm (Hong Kong time): online admissions webinar via Zoom.
  • Rolling review and interviews: carried out as applications arrive, with provisional offers also announced on a rolling basis.
  • 12:00 noon (Hong Kong time), 15 January 2027: application deadline. The website adds that applicants who have not heard by 31 May 2027 may contact the school.

Because review is rolling, having both videos ready and applying early is generally an advantage.

Who is it for?

  1. People with filmmaking experience who want to bring generative AI into their work: the entry film must be at least 5 minutes, so you need a complete piece rather than fragments.
  2. Design, architecture, animation or media graduates moving into visual storytelling: the website prefers film or media backgrounds but does not restrict undergraduate subjects; what matters is a film in which you can clearly explain your role.
  3. Those who want a longer, more hands-on taught master's in Hong Kong than the usual one-year format: the 1.5-year duration leaves more production time for the capstone.

The author's advice (not an official requirement): the point of the application is not to show how many AI tools you can use but to answer the website's question, "what makes a good AI film?" Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consultation, we have seen that the moving-image work that convinces reviewers usually has a clear question behind it and a clearly defined personal role. Write down the story you want to tell through AI first, then choose your entry film, and state honestly in the credit list which parts you were responsible for. For HKU's undergraduate design and architecture admissions, see our guide to Hong Kong design and architecture undergraduate degrees for 2027.

Official sources checked: HKU School of Future Media MACAIFM home page, programme details, application details, master's scholarships and HKU 2027 programme information (checked October 2026).

title.en: How to apply to CMU's Master of Human-Computer Interaction (MHCI): 2027 entry requirements, TOEFL/IELTS, portfolio, tuition and deadline (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 卡內基美隆大學（CMU）人機交互碩士 MHCI 2027-28 屆申請已開放，2027 年 1 月 15 日截止。對照官網整理 1 年 3 學期、7 門核心課與 7 個月 Capstone 畢業項目、TOEFL 單項 25／IELTS 8.5 英文門檻、目的陳述與 1 分鐘影片等申請材料、選交作品集、每學期 31,100 美元學費與申請時間線。
summary.en: Applications for the 2027-28 cohort of Carnegie Mellon's Master of Human-Computer Interaction (MHCI) are open until 15 January 2027. Checked against the official website: the one-year, three-semester structure, seven core courses and the seven-month Capstone, the TOEFL 25-per-section / IELTS 8.5 English bar, the Statement of Purpose and one-minute video essay, the optional portfolio, US$31,100-per-semester tuition and the application timeline.

tldr.zh-Hant: CMU MHCI 由人機交互研究所開辦，創立於 1997 年；1 年 3 學期（8 月到隔年 8 月）全日制、STEM 學位，7 門核心課＋4 門選修，含 7 個月業界 Capstone 畢業項目；不限本科背景，非技術背景開學前補程式先修；英文 TOEFL 每單項 25 以上或 IELTS 8.5（單項 8.0）或 Duolingo 130（單項 125），不予豁免；必交 500 字目的陳述、3 封推薦信、履歷、成績單、1 分鐘影片，GRE 與作品集選交；2026-27 學費每學期 31,100 美元，課程本身不提供資助；2027 年 1 月 15 日下午 3 點（美東）截止。
tldr.en: CMU's MHCI, run by the Human-Computer Interaction Institute since 1997, is a one-year, three-semester (August to August) full-time STEM master's with seven core courses, four electives and a seven-month industry Capstone. Any undergraduate background is accepted, and non-technical students complete a programming requirement before starting. English requires at least 25 on each TOEFL iBT section, IELTS 8.5 (no band below 8.0) or Duolingo 130 (no subscore below 125), with no waivers. Required materials are a 500-word Statement of Purpose, three letters, a résumé, transcripts and a one-minute video essay; GRE and portfolio are optional. 2026-27 tuition is US$31,100 per semester, the programme offers no funding, and the deadline is 3:00 pm EST on 15 January 2027.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：卡內基美隆大學（CMU）人機交互研究所（HCII）的 Master of Human-Computer Interaction（MHCI，人機交互碩士），是官網自稱創立於 1997 年、全球第一個同類型的研究生學位。它是 1 年、3 個學期（8 月到隔年 8 月）的全日制專業碩士，屬 STEM 學位，畢業要修 7 門核心課＋4 門選修，其中最重要的是與真實業界客戶合作、長達 7 個月的 Capstone 畢業項目。2027-28 屆申請已開放，截止時間是 2027 年 1 月 15 日下午 3 點（美東時間），沒有提前批。作品集是選交，必交的是 500 字目的陳述、3 封推薦信、履歷、成績單，以及一支 1 分鐘的影片短文；英文要求很高：TOEFL 每個單項至少 25 分、IELTS 總分 8.5 且單項不低於 8.0。

以下內容於 2026 年 10 月對照 CMU HCII 官網的 MHCI 課程首頁、申請頁、課程結構頁、Capstone 頁、學費頁與常見問題頁查核。早期流傳的資料（例如以人民幣估算的年度總費用）已改為官網公布的 2026-27 學年學費；無法在官網查到出處的數字一律刪除。

文首封面是 MHCI 申請頁上的 HCII 辦公大樓（300 S. Craig Street）照片。圖片來源：卡內基美隆大學 HCII 官網

CMU MHCI 是什麼樣的碩士？適合設計背景嗎？

官網的定位是「規劃、設計、建造與評估未來科技」的跨領域專業碩士，學生的興趣可以是軟體工程、產品管理、設計、研究、創業、資料科學、公共政策、AI、機器人或 XR。申請頁明確寫著不要求特定學位或背景，同屆學生來自設計、社會科學、商科、電腦科學等領域。

對設計、建築背景的申請者，常見問題頁回答得很直接：沒有扎實的程式背景也歡迎申請；非技術背景的學生要在秋季開學前，透過外部課程或系上的線上程式課完成程式先修要求，之後再依背景二選一修 PIX（給非技術背景）或 SSUI（給技術背景）。課程只能在匹茲堡全程到校修讀，沒有線上學位。

官網常見問題頁公布：2025 年秋季入學 57 位 MHCI 學生；2025-26 申請季錄取率 23%，每年會變動。

MHCI 要修哪些課？Capstone 畢業項目怎麼做？

畢業要求為 7 門核心課與 4 門選修，全日制每學期至少 36 個單位（大多課程每門 9 或 12 個單位）。官網列出的 7 門核心課為：

  • 05-600 HCI Pro-Seminar：與研究者、業界人士交流，加上職涯、溝通、團隊與引導技巧訓練。
  • 05-610 以使用者為中心的研究與評估（UCRE）：觀察研究、訪談、可用性評估等質性與量化混合方法。
  • 05-660 互動設計基礎：動手做的工作室課，從發想、草圖、分鏡、線框到快速原型與使用者測試，不需要寫程式（可依程度抵免）。
  • 05-661 進階互動設計：設計系統、無障礙、資料導向的設計決策，把設計能力推到接近業界水準。
  • 05-635 PIX 或 05-631 SSUI 二選一：互動體驗程式設計，或使用者介面的軟體結構。
  • 05-671 HCI Project I（春季 15 單位）與 05-672 HCI Project II（夏季 48 單位）：也就是 Capstone。

Capstone 是官網形容「最有價值也最具挑戰」的經驗：每組 4 至 6 位 MHCI 學生，在教師每週指導下，與真實的贊助機構合作 7 個月。春季深入客戶的組織與產業，做市場、利害關係人與使用者研究並提出策略建議；夏季全職到校，反覆原型、測試與修正，最後向客戶交付研究成果、策略建議與可運作的原型，有些團隊甚至做到可直接延續開發的 MVP。官網也說明，學生擁有自己開發成果的智慧財產權，再授予贊助方非獨家、免權利金的使用許可。

申請條件是什麼？雅思、托福要多少？

  • 學歷：入學前取得四年制學士學位或同等學歷，不限本科專業。
  • TOEFL（優先）：iBT 每個單項至少 25 分；新制 TOEFL iBT（1–6 級制）總分 5.5 且單項不低於 5.0；2024 年 9 月 1 日前的考試不接受，成績須在兩年內。
  • IELTS：總分 8.5，單項不低於 8.0。
  • Duolingo：總分 130 以上，單項不低於 125（官網強烈建議優先考 TOEFL 或 IELTS）。
  • 英文豁免：以 F-1／J-1 簽證就讀且母語非英語者一律要考，官網明言不因在美國或其他英語授課學校的學歷而豁免。
  • GRE：選交，沒有最低分。

要交作品集嗎？申請材料有哪些？

  1. 目的陳述（Statement of Purpose）：最多 500 字、PDF，回答兩題：你希望透過 HCI 職涯產生什麼影響、HCI 實踐者對社會負有什麼責任、為什麼 CMU MHCI 是下一步；以及一段徹底改變你思考、工作或領導方式的經驗。
  2. 3 封推薦信：強烈建議至少兩封來自教師或近期雇主；官網請推薦人評論你的協作能力、面對挑戰與回饋的態度，以及能否承受每週 60 小時以上工作量的一年制課程。
  3. 1 分鐘影片短文（必交）：本人出鏡、從 6 題中選 1 題回答，例如「科技在什麼時候不該被用來解決問題？」；官網說明不評估拍攝與剪輯技巧，用手機錄製即可。
  4. 履歷、成績單（英文 PDF）。
  5. 作品範例（選交）：可以是設計作品集、GitHub、研究報告、寫作樣本、創業或社區項目等，官網明言不是錄取必要條件。

申請費 100 美元，有經濟困難可申請費用減免（截止前一週提出）。官網也提到大多數申請者不需面試，通常只依書面材料決定。

學費多少？有獎學金嗎？

  • 學費：2026-27 學年全日制每學期 31,100 美元，以學期計算，僅含學費、不含學雜費與生活費；學費由校董會每年訂定，2027-28 屆可能調整。
  • 資助：官網明言 MHCI 本身不提供學生經濟資助，建議查詢 CMU 財務援助與獎學金辦公室；課程有參與 CMU Rales Fellows 計畫（面向資源不足背景的 STEM 學生）。

2027 申請時間線怎麼排？

  • 2026 年秋季：申請開放（2027-28 屆已開放）。
  • 2026 年 11 月 5 日（週四）8:00–9:00、11 月 11 日（週三）19:00–20:00（美東時間）：線上說明會。
  • 2026 年 12 月 19 日至 2027 年 1 月 3 日：MHCI 招生辦公室寒假休息，有問題要提早問。
  • 2027 年 1 月 15 日下午 3 點（美東時間）：申請與推薦信截止；每年只收秋季入學一次。

設計、建築背景怎麼準備最有利？

作者建議（非官方要求）：MHCI 的作品集雖然選交，但對設計、建築背景的申請者來說，它是證明你「會研究、會做原型、會和團隊合作」最直接的地方，建議仍然提交，並把重點放在研究過程與迭代，而不是只放漂亮的成品。我們在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中看到，從空間設計轉到 HCI 的申請者，最有說服力的往往是把一個空間或服務問題，用使用者研究重新定義、再用原型驗證的完整過程。另外，英文分數門檻非常高，建議把 TOEFL 單項 25 分當成第一個要先解決的項目。想比較其他美國的互動設計碩士，可參考我們的康奈爾互動設計類碩士比較。

官方查核來源：CMU HCII MHCI 課程首頁、申請資訊、課程結構、Capstone 畢業項目、學費與資助、常見問題（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the Master of Human-Computer Interaction (MHCI) at Carnegie Mellon University's Human-Computer Interaction Institute (HCII) was founded in 1997 and, according to the official website, was the first graduate programme of its kind. It is a one-year, three-semester (August to August) full-time professional master's and a STEM-designated degree. Students complete seven core courses and four electives, centred on a seven-month industry Capstone with a real external client. Applications for the 2027-28 cohort are open and close at 3:00 pm EST on 15 January 2027, with no early deadline. A portfolio is optional; required materials are a 500-word Statement of Purpose, three letters of recommendation, a résumé, transcripts and a one-minute video essay. The English bar is high: at least 25 on each TOEFL iBT section, or IELTS 8.5 overall with no band below 8.0.

Everything below was checked in October 2026 against the HCII website's MHCI overview, admissions, curriculum, Capstone, tuition and FAQ pages. Earlier figures in circulation (such as an annual total cost estimated in Chinese yuan) have been replaced with the official 2026-27 tuition, and any number without an official source has been removed.

The cover shows the HCII building at 300 S. Craig Street, as pictured on the MHCI admissions page. Image source: Carnegie Mellon University HCII website

What kind of master's is CMU's MHCI, and does it suit design graduates?

The website describes an interdisciplinary professional master's that prepares students to plan, design, build and evaluate future technologies, with interests ranging from software engineering, product management, design and research to entrepreneurship, data science, public policy, AI, robotics and XR. The admissions page states that no specific degree or background is required, and cohorts include students from design, the social sciences, business, computer science and more.

For design and architecture applicants, the FAQ is direct: you are encouraged to apply without a strong programming background. Non-technical students complete a programming requirement before the fall, through an external course or the department's online course, and then take either PIX (for non-technical students) or SSUI (for technical students). The programme requires in-person attendance in Pittsburgh and is not offered online.

The FAQ reports 57 MHCI students matriculating in fall 2025 and a 23% acceptance rate in the 2025-26 cycle, which varies from year to year.

What do MHCI students study, and how does the Capstone work?

Students take seven core courses and four electives; full-time study means at least 36 units per semester, with most courses worth 9 or 12 units. The seven core courses are:

  • 05-600 HCI Pro-Seminar: conversations with researchers and industry experts plus career, communication, teamwork and facilitation training.
  • 05-610 User-Centered Research and Evaluation (UCRE): mixed methods including observation, interviews and usability evaluation.
  • 05-660 Interaction Design Fundamentals: a hands-on studio from ideation, sketching and storyboarding to wireframes, rapid prototypes and user testing, with no coding required (students may place out).
  • 05-661 Advanced Interaction Design: design systems, accessibility and data-informed decisions, taking design skills to a near-professional level.
  • 05-635 PIX or 05-631 SSUI: programming interactive experiences, or software structures for user interfaces.
  • 05-671 HCI Project I (15 units, spring) and 05-672 HCI Project II (48 units, summer): the Capstone.

The website calls the Capstone both the most valuable and the most challenging experience of the programme. Teams of four to six MHCI students, mentored weekly by faculty, work with a real sponsor for seven months. In spring they immerse themselves in the client's organisation and industry, carrying out market, stakeholder and user research and presenting strategic recommendations; in summer they work full time in person, prototyping, testing and refining, and deliver research findings, recommendations and a functional prototype, with some teams going as far as a minimum viable product. Students own the intellectual property they develop and grant the sponsor a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence.

What are the entry requirements, and what IELTS or TOEFL score do I need?

  • Degree: a four-year bachelor's degree or equivalent by matriculation, in any subject.
  • TOEFL (preferred): at least 25 on each iBT section; on the new TOEFL iBT (1–6 scale), 5.5 overall with no section below 5.0. Tests taken before 1 September 2024 are not accepted, and scores must be no older than two years.
  • IELTS: 8.5 overall with no band below 8.0.
  • Duolingo: 130 or higher overall with no subscore below 125 (the website strongly encourages TOEFL or IELTS first).
  • Waivers: non-native speakers studying on an F-1 or J-1 visa must submit a test; no waivers are issued for previous study in English, in the US or elsewhere.
  • GRE: optional, with no minimum score.

Do I need a portfolio, and what are the application materials?

  1. Statement of Purpose: up to 500 words as a PDF, answering two prompts: the impact you hope to have through an HCI career, the responsibility HCI practitioners have to society and why CMU's MHCI is your next step; and an experience that fundamentally changed how you think, work or lead.
  2. Three letters of recommendation: at least two from faculty or recent employers are strongly recommended; recommenders are asked about your collaboration, how you handle challenges and feedback, and your ability to thrive in a one-year programme with a 60+ hour weekly workload.
  3. One-minute video essay (required): appear on camera and answer one of six prompts, such as "When do you think technology should NOT be used to solve a problem?"; production and editing are not assessed, and a phone recording is fine.
  4. Résumé and transcripts (in English, as PDFs).
  5. Examples of work (optional): a design portfolio, GitHub repository, research reports, writing samples, entrepreneurial or community projects and so on; the website says they are not required for admission.

The application fee is US$100, with fee waivers available for financial hardship (request at least one week before the deadline). The website also notes that most applicants are not interviewed; decisions are usually based on the submitted materials.

How much is tuition, and is there funding?

  • Tuition: US$31,100 per semester for full-time students in 2026-27, charged per semester and covering tuition only (not fees or living costs). Rates are set annually by the Board of Trustees and may change for the 2027-28 cohort.
  • Funding: the website states that the MHCI programme does not provide financial support, pointing applicants to CMU's financial aid and fellowships offices; the programme participates in the CMU Rales Fellows programme for STEM students from under-resourced backgrounds.

What is the 2027 application timeline?

  • Autumn 2026: the application opens (the 2027-28 cohort application is open now).
  • Thursday 5 November 2026, 8:00–9:00 am ET, and Wednesday 11 November 2026, 7:00–8:00 pm ET: virtual information sessions.
  • 19 December 2026 to 3 January 2027: the MHCI admissions office is closed for winter break, so ask questions early.
  • 15 January 2027, 3:00 pm EST: deadline for applications and recommendation letters; admission is for the fall term only, once a year.

How should design and architecture applicants prepare?

The author's advice (not an official requirement): although the portfolio is optional, for design and architecture applicants it is the most direct way to show that you can research, prototype and work in a team, so we recommend submitting one that focuses on research and iteration rather than only polished results. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consultation, we have seen that the most convincing applicants moving from spatial design into HCI usually show a complete process: reframing a spatial or service problem through user research, then testing it with prototypes. The English thresholds are also very high, so treat 25 on every TOEFL section as the first item to secure. To compare other US interaction design master's degrees, see our comparison of Cornell's interaction design master's programmes.

Official sources checked: CMU HCII MHCI overview, admissions, curriculum, Capstone, tuition and financial aid and FAQs (checked October 2026).

q.zh-Hant: CMU MHCI 讀幾年？學費多少？
q.en: How long is CMU MHCI, and how much does it cost?

a.zh-Hant: 1 年、3 個學期（8 月到隔年 8 月）全日制；2026-27 學年學費為每學期 31,100 美元（僅學費，不含學雜費與生活費），每年可能調整。
a.en: It is one year and three semesters (August to August) full time; 2026-27 tuition is US$31,100 per semester (tuition only, excluding fees and living costs), and rates may change each year.

q.zh-Hant: 雅思、托福要多少分？可以豁免嗎？
q.en: What IELTS or TOEFL score is required, and can it be waived?

a.zh-Hant: TOEFL iBT 每個單項至少 25 分（新制 1–6 級為總分 5.5、單項 5.0），或 IELTS 總分 8.5、單項 8.0，或 Duolingo 130、單項 125；以 F-1／J-1 簽證就讀的非英語母語者不予豁免。
a.en: At least 25 on each TOEFL iBT section (5.5 overall with no section below 5.0 on the new 1–6 scale), IELTS 8.5 with no band below 8.0, or Duolingo 130 with no subscore below 125; no waivers for non-native speakers on F-1 or J-1 visas.

q.zh-Hant: 一定要交作品集嗎？
q.en: Is a portfolio required?

a.zh-Hant: 不一定。官網列為選交，可以是設計作品集、GitHub、研究報告等；必交的是 500 字目的陳述、3 封推薦信、履歷、成績單與 1 分鐘影片短文。
a.en: No. Examples of work, such as a design portfolio, GitHub repository or research reports, are optional; required materials are a 500-word Statement of Purpose, three letters, a résumé, transcripts and a one-minute video essay.

q.zh-Hant: 沒有程式背景可以申請嗎？
q.en: Can I apply without a programming background?

a.zh-Hant: 可以。官網鼓勵設計、心理、商科等背景申請；非技術背景的學生須在開學前完成程式先修要求，入學後修給非技術背景的 PIX 課。
a.en: Yes. The website encourages applicants from design, psychology, business and other fields; non-technical students complete a programming requirement before starting and then take PIX, the course for non-technical students.

q.zh-Hant: 2027 入學什麼時候截止？
q.en: When is the deadline for 2027 entry?

a.zh-Hant: 2027 年 1 月 15 日下午 3 點（美東時間），推薦信也須在同一時間前上傳；沒有提前批，每年只收秋季入學。
a.en: 3:00 pm EST on 15 January 2027, which is also the deadline for recommendation letters; there is no early deadline and admission is for the fall term only.

summary.en: Applications for the 2027-28 cohort of the University of Washington's Master of Human-Computer Interaction + Design (MHCI+D) close on 18 January 2027. Checked against the official website: the 11-month, 46-credit curriculum, the three-quarter Capstone, the IELTS 7.5 (speaking 8.0) / new TOEFL 5.0 English bar, the required project materials and one-minute video, estimated tuition of US$63,618 and the application timeline.

tldr.zh-Hant: UW MHCI+D 於 2012 年由電腦科學、HCDE、資訊學院與藝術設計學院合辦；11 個月全日制 STEM 學位，至少 46 學分（核心 39＋選修 7），含跨冬春夏三學季的 Capstone；學士學位、GPA 3.0；IELTS 7.5 且口說 8.0，或 TOEFL iBT 新制 5.0（口說 5.0）／舊制 106（口說 26），或 Duolingo 135；必交 500–800 字個人陳述、履歷、3 封推薦信、成績單，以及含項目連結的一頁 PDF 與 1 分鐘影片；學費每學分 1,383 美元、估算 63,618 美元；申請費 90 美元；2027 年 1 月 18 日截止，3 月中發榜。
tldr.en: UW's MHCI+D, founded in 2012 by Computer Science & Engineering, HCDE, the iSchool and the School of Art, Art History & Design, is an 11-month full-time STEM master's of at least 46 credits (39 core plus 7 elective) with a Capstone spanning winter, spring and summer. It requires a bachelor's degree and a 3.0 GPA, plus IELTS 7.5 with 8.0 speaking, TOEFL iBT 5.0 with 5.0 speaking on the new scale (106 with 26 speaking for earlier tests) or Duolingo 135. Required materials are a 500–800-word personal statement, résumé, three letters, transcripts and a one-page PDF of project links with a one-minute video. Tuition is US$1,383 per credit, an estimated US$63,618; the fee is US$90; the deadline is 18 January 2027, with decisions in mid-March.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：華盛頓大學（University of Washington，西雅圖）的 Master of Human-Computer Interaction + Design（MHCI+D，人機交互與設計碩士）是一個 11 個月、以同屆小組（cohort）為單位的全日制專業碩士，屬 STEM 學位，畢業至少修 46 學分（核心 39 學分＋選修至少 7 學分），核心是橫跨冬、春、夏三個學季的 Capstone 畢業項目。2027-28 學年申請已於 10 月 1 日開放，截止日是 2027 年 1 月 18 日。它和多數 HCI 碩士最大的不同是：作品／項目材料加 1 分鐘影片是必交的補充材料，對設計、建築背景很友善；英文門檻也高：IELTS 總分 7.5 且口說至少 8.0，或新制 TOEFL iBT 5.0 且口說 5.0。官網估算學費約 63,618 美元。

以下內容於 2026 年 10 月對照 UW MHCI+D 官網的課程首頁、申請頁（Apply）、職涯發展頁（Grow）查核。早期流傳的資料（例如托福 80、雅思 6 的最低分、約 6 萬美元的平均學費）已改為官網現行要求；無法在官網查到出處的數字一律刪除。

文首封面是 MHCI+D 官網 Engage 頁上的新工作室空間。圖片來源：華盛頓大學 MHCI+D 官網

UW MHCI+D 是什麼樣的碩士？適合設計背景嗎？

MHCI+D 於 2012 年成立，由華盛頓大學四個單位共同開辦：Paul G. Allen 電腦科學與工程學院、以人為本設計與工程系（HCDE）、資訊學院（Information School），以及藝術、藝術史與設計學院。官網的定位是把設計、技術與以人為本的研究方法交織在一起，用工作室（studio）實作加上研討課與講座的方式，在一年內讓學生具備進入科技業設計、研究與原型開發職位的能力。

申請頁寫明的最低條件只有：受認可大學的學士學位，以及換算成 4.0 制至少 3.0 的 GPA（可用全部課程、最近兩年，或本科專業課的 GPA 擇一計算）。它看重的是你「怎麼解決問題」：補充材料要求展示能體現創造、設計或迭代過程的項目，官網特別說明更在意你在原本領域中的解題過程，而不是你能否預先做出入學後才會做的作品。這對設計、建築背景的申請者是相當直接的優勢。

MHCI+D 要修哪些課？Capstone 畢業項目怎麼做？

全程 11 個月，從秋季學季開學前的 5 天密集工作坊開始，依學季排課：

  • 開學前（2 學分）：HCID 501 Immersion Studio，5 天密集工作坊，建立 HCI 與設計的核心概念和工作室學習方式。
  • 秋季：HCID 530 可用性／使用者研究（3 學分）；HCID 511 Ideation Studio 發想工作室（5 學分），聚焦辨識人的行為並用科技介入改變行為。
  • 冬季：HCID 520 使用者介面軟硬體（3 學分）；HCID 521 Prototyping Studio 原型工作室（5 學分），做實體運算、軟硬體整合與不同保真度的原型；HCID 540 Capstone 規劃（2 學分）。
  • 春季：HCID 510 互動系統設計（3 學分）；HCID 531 Research Studio 研究工作室（5 學分），把形成性與評估性研究方法用在 Capstone 上；以及作品集課程，準備線上作品集與作品集簡報。
  • 夏季：HCID 541 Capstone Studio（8 學分），為期 9 週的密集課程，持續迭代設計、原型與評估。

Capstone 是官網所說的課程基石：從冬季組隊、提出一個「未來的……」主題，到春季研究、夏季設計與製作，橫跨三個學季，學生團隊在教師與業界顧問指導下完成完整的解決方案或產品設計，題目可能涉及健康、環境、教育、輔助科技、零售或旅遊等領域，並在畢業前一天的公開 Capstone 展上發表。選修可從全校研究所程度（400 以上）課程中選，多數學生一年修 2 至 3 門，常見的有資料視覺化、互動設計、視覺溝通、質性研究方法、價值敏感設計等。

申請條件是什麼？雅思、托福要多少？

  • 學歷與 GPA：學士學位或同等學歷；GPA 換算 4.0 制至少 3.0。
  • TOEFL iBT：2026 年 1 月 21 日起的新制成績須達 5.0、口說至少 5.0；該日前的舊制成績須達 106、口說至少 26。不接受 MyBest 合併成績。
  • IELTS：總分 7.5，口說至少 8.0。
  • Duolingo：至少 135。
  • 效期與豁免：成績在申請截止日時須未滿兩年。若在美國、英國、加拿大、澳洲、新加坡等官網列出的國家以英語授課取得學位（且在校就讀），或在其他國家取得可證明全英語授課的學士學位，可用學歷證明英文能力。

要交作品集嗎？申請材料有哪些？

  1. 個人陳述（Personal Statement）：500–800 字，說明你對 HCI 與設計的興趣、課程哪些部分符合你的需要、為什麼是今年、過去經驗如何讓你準備好、如何把個人倫理放進工作，以及課程如何幫助長期目標。
  2. 履歷或 CV。
  3. 3 封推薦信：來自教師、導師、主管等學術或專業來源，不接受朋友、輔導員或神職人員；官網建議請推薦人寫出具體例子。
  4. 非正式成績單：自行上傳，非英文需附翻譯；錄取並接受後才需寄正式成績單。
  5. 補充材料（必交）：一頁 PDF，寫上姓名與完整網址連結，內含 (1) 最能展示你創造、設計或迭代能力的項目，可以是設計作品集、GitHub、參與的研究項目或任何清楚標明你角色的開放式項目，放在作品集網站或雲端資料夾，不要直接上傳到申請系統；(2) 1 分鐘影片，介紹其中最讓你興奮的一個項目、你的角色與貢獻，以及這份熱情如何成為你帶進課程的優勢，可放在 YouTube、Vimeo 或雲端。

申請費 90 美元，由 UW 研究生院收取、不退費；費用減免只開放給符合資格的美國本地申請者。官網說明只有少數申請者會被面試，錄取或拒絕通知於 3 月中以 email 發出，錄取者約需在 4 月 15 日前回覆，另設有候補名單。

學費多少？有獎學金嗎？

  • 學費：MHCI+D 是自負盈虧（self-sustaining）的收費課程，按學分計費，州內、州外與國際學生同價：每學分 1,383 美元，至少 46 學分，官網估算學費 63,618 美元；另有每學季的註冊費、科技費與 U-Pass 交通卡等必繳費用。
  • 資助：官網說明多數學生以貸款和個人積蓄支付；因課程不受州政府撥款，不適用部分獎學金與學費減免計畫；符合資格者可申請 UW GSEE 的 Graduate Supplemental Award（依經濟需求、競爭激烈）。
  • 其他：上課必須自備筆電。課程為 STEM 學位，畢業生可申請 12 個月 OPT，並可能符合再延長 24 個月的 STEM OPT。

2027 申請時間線怎麼排？

  • 2026 年 10 月 1 日：2027-28 學年申請開放。
  • 2026 年 11 月 16 日（週一）8:00–9:30、12 月 7 日（週一）16:00–17:30（美西時間）：線上說明會（10 月 19 日場次已有錄影）。
  • 2027 年 1 月 18 日：申請截止，送出後無法修改。
  • 2027 年 3 月中：以 email 發出錄取與拒絕通知；錄取者約 4 月 15 日前回覆。

設計、建築背景怎麼準備最有利？

作者建議（非官方要求）：MHCI+D 的補充材料只看「你的角色」和「你的解題過程」，所以設計、建築背景的申請者不必硬做 App 介面，與其放很多漂亮成品，不如挑 2 至 3 個項目，清楚交代問題怎麼被定義、你做了哪些研究與草模、怎麼根據回饋迭代。我們在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中看到，從空間設計轉到 HCI 最有說服力的作品，往往是把一個空間或服務的使用者問題講清楚，再用原型驗證的完整過程；那支 1 分鐘影片則最好就講這個項目，讓審閱者聽到你自己的判斷。英文方面，IELTS 口說 8.0 的門檻比總分更難，建議盡早把口說當成第一個要解決的項目。想比較匹茲堡的同類課程，可參考我們的 CMU 人機交互碩士 MHCI 申請整理。

官方查核來源：UW MHCI+D 課程首頁、申請、學費與國際學生資訊、職涯發展、Engage 頁（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the University of Washington's Master of Human-Computer Interaction + Design (MHCI+D) in Seattle is an 11-month, cohort-based, full-time professional master's and a STEM-designated degree. Students earn at least 46 credits (39 core credits plus at least 7 elective credits), built around a Capstone that runs across the winter, spring and summer quarters. Applications for 2027-28 opened on 1 October and close on 18 January 2027. What sets it apart from many HCI master's is that project materials plus a one-minute video are required supplementary materials, which suits design and architecture applicants well. The English bar is high: IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 8.0 in speaking, or TOEFL iBT 5.0 on the new scale with a speaking score of at least 5.0. The website estimates tuition at US$63,618.

Everything below was checked in October 2026 against the MHCI+D website's overview, Apply and Grow pages. Earlier figures in circulation (such as minimums of TOEFL 80 and IELTS 6, or average tuition of about US$60,000) have been replaced with the current official requirements, and any number without an official source has been removed.

The cover shows the new studio space featured on the Engage page of the MHCI+D website. Image source: University of Washington MHCI+D website

What kind of master's is UW's MHCI+D, and does it suit design graduates?

MHCI+D was founded in 2012 as a joint initiative of four UW units: the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, Human Centered Design and Engineering (HCDE), the Information School and the School of Art, Art History & Design. The website describes a programme that interleaves design, technology and human-centred research methods, combining hands-on studio learning with seminars and lectures to prepare students for demanding technology careers in a single year.

The stated minimum requirements are simply a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution and a GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (calculated on the whole degree, the last two years, or courses in your major). What matters is how you solve problems: the supplementary materials ask for projects that show your ability to create, design or iterate, and the website stresses that it is more interested in your problem-solving process within your own field than in anticipating the work you might do after the programme. That is a direct advantage for design and architecture applicants.

What do MHCI+D students study, and how does the Capstone work?

The 11-month programme begins with a five-day intensive before the autumn quarter and is organised by quarter:

  • Pre-autumn (2 credits): HCID 501 Immersion Studio, a five-day workshop introducing core HCI and design ideas and studio-based learning.
  • Autumn: HCID 530 Usability/User Research (3 credits) and HCID 511 Ideation Studio (5 credits), which focuses on identifying human behaviours and using technology interventions to change them.
  • Winter: HCID 520 on user interface software and hardware (3 credits); HCID 521 Prototyping Studio (5 credits), covering physical computing, hardware-software integration and prototypes of varying fidelity; and HCID 540 Capstone Planning (2 credits).
  • Spring: HCID 510 Design of Interactive Systems (3 credits); HCID 531 Research Studio (5 credits), applying formative and evaluative research to the Capstone; and a portfolio course preparing an online portfolio and portfolio presentation.
  • Summer: HCID 541 Capstone Studio (8 credits), a nine-week intensive of iterative design, prototyping and evaluation.

The website calls the Capstone the cornerstone of the programme. Spanning three quarters, from forming teams around a "future of" topic in winter to research in spring and design and build in summer, student teams work with faculty and industry advisors to produce a comprehensive solution or product design, in domains such as health, the environment, education, assistive technology, retail or travel, and present it at a public Capstone Showcase the day before graduation. Electives can be chosen from graduate-level (400 and above) courses across campus; most students take two or three, with popular options including data visualisation, interaction design, visual communication, qualitative research methods and value sensitive design.

What are the entry requirements, and what IELTS or TOEFL score do I need?

  • Degree and GPA: a bachelor's degree or equivalent, with a GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
  • TOEFL iBT: for tests taken from 21 January 2026, 5.0 with a speaking score of at least 5.0; for earlier tests, 106 with a speaking score of at least 26. MyBest composite scores are not accepted.
  • IELTS: 7.5 overall with a speaking score of at least 8.0.
  • Duolingo: at least 135.
  • Validity and alternatives: scores must be less than two years old at the application deadline. A degree taught in English from an institution in one of the listed countries (including the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Singapore, with on-campus residence), or a bachelor's degree from elsewhere with verified English-medium instruction, can also meet the requirement.

Do I need a portfolio, and what are the application materials?

  1. Personal statement: 500–800 words on your interest in HCI and design, which parts of the programme fit your needs, why this year, how your experience has prepared you, how you will bring your personal ethics into your work and how the programme supports your longer-term goals.
  2. Résumé or CV.
  3. Three letters of recommendation: from academic or professional sources such as faculty, mentors or supervisors, not personal friends, counsellors or ministers; the website notes that letters with specific examples are often strongest.
  4. Unofficial transcripts: uploaded by you, with translations if not in English; official transcripts are needed only after accepting an offer.
  5. Supplementary materials (required): a one-page PDF with your name and full URLs, covering (1) projects that best demonstrate your ability to create, design or iterate, such as a design portfolio, GitHub page, research project or any open-ended project with your role clearly defined, hosted on a website or shared folder rather than uploaded to the application; and (2) a one-minute video discussing the project that most excites you, your role and contributions, and how that enthusiasm reflects the strengths you would bring, hosted on YouTube, Vimeo or cloud storage.

The non-refundable US$90 application fee is charged by the UW Graduate School; fee waivers are available only to eligible domestic applicants. Only some applicants are interviewed. Offers and denials are emailed in mid-March, admitted students are asked to reply by around 15 April, and a limited waitlist is used.

How much is tuition, and is there funding?

  • Tuition: MHCI+D is a self-sustaining, fee-based programme charged per credit, at the same rate for Washington residents, non-residents and international students: US$1,383 per credit for at least 46 credits, giving an estimated tuition of US$63,618. Quarterly registration and technology fees and the U-Pass transit pass are charged on top.
  • Funding: the website says most students combine loans and personal savings. Because the programme receives no state funding, it does not qualify for some scholarships and tuition exemption programmes; eligible students may apply for a need-based, highly competitive Graduate Supplemental Award through UW's GSEE.
  • Other: every student must have a laptop. As a STEM programme, graduates are eligible for 12 months of OPT and may qualify for a further 24-month STEM OPT extension.

What is the 2027 application timeline?

  • 1 October 2026: applications for 2027-28 open.
  • Monday 16 November 2026, 8:00–9:30 am PST, and Monday 7 December 2026, 4:00–5:30 pm PST: online information sessions (the 19 October session is available as a recording).
  • 18 January 2027: application deadline; no changes can be made after submission.
  • Mid-March 2027: offers and denials are sent by email; admitted students reply by around 15 April.

How should design and architecture applicants prepare?

The author's advice (not an official requirement): MHCI+D's supplementary materials focus on your role and your problem-solving process, so design and architecture applicants do not need to force out app interfaces. Rather than many polished results, choose two or three projects and show clearly how the problem was framed, what research and study models you made and how you iterated on feedback. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consultation, we have seen that the most convincing work from applicants moving from spatial design into HCI usually sets out a user problem in a space or service and then tests it with prototypes; the one-minute video is best spent on that same project, so reviewers hear your own judgement. On English, the IELTS 8.0 speaking threshold is harder than the overall score, so treat speaking as the first item to secure. To compare a similar programme in Pittsburgh, see our guide to applying for CMU's MHCI.

Official sources checked: UW MHCI+D overview, admissions, tuition and international student information, career development and the Engage page (checked October 2026).
